d: Somewhere beyond the reach of human eyes, rare creatures may still be surviving against the odds. Wildlife biologist Forrest Galante sets out to investigate extraordinary animal mysteries, following clues and possible sightings linked to the Cape Lion, Ivory-billed Woodpecker, Fernandina Tortoise, Rio Apaporis Caiman, Saola (the Asian Unicorn) and Caribbean Monk Seal. Each search takes him into remote habitats where evidence is scarce, and the possibility of finding these elusive species remains uncertain.
